description:
WHEN an agent already knows its ideal customer profile and wants the
    matching open roles as rows it can act on: several countries, an
    industry, a headcount band and title keywords in ONE call, instead of a
    search followed by a lookup per company. `criteria` takes up to three
    groups -- `company` (country, industry, industry_terms, headcount_band,
    company_kind), `req` (q, q_excludes, seniority_level, function,
    skills, remote_type, location) and `event` (company_id,
    board, source_type, ats_vendor, country) -- AND across fields, OR within
    one.
    A field outside that list is an explicit error, never quietly dropped.
    criteria={"company": {"country": ["United States", "Germany"]},
    "req": {"q": ["backend engineer"]}} -> live backend roles in
    both countries, each row naming the company and carrying the posting
    URL, seniority, skills and declared or estimated yearly pay.
    `salary_min_usd` / `salary_max_usd` bracket that pay. Agencies and
    expired postings are excluded by default. Page with `cursor` (the
    previous `next_cursor`); `limit` is bounded. Billed per row returned, and
    an empty page bills nothing. Needs an API key: without one the answer is
    a signup link. For a first look at who is hiring before you have a key,
    use `who_is_hiring_for`.
